title: ISO 21771-2:2025 — Cylindrical involute gears and gear pairs — Part 2: Calculation and measurement of tooth thickness and backlash
locator: Official catalogue abstract and scope: calculation procedures for tooth thickness and backlash; scope includes external/internal spur and helical gears, involute worms, crossed-axis gears and racks
notes: The document provides calculation and measurement relationships but explicitly does not select tooth thickness or tolerance values. It does not replace application-specific design, paired-gear inspection or machine-axis positioning tests. Full text is not archived.
